judgments.reason: The support span 'Biopsies from the stomach, duodenum, terminal ileum, colon, and rectum all demonstrated non-caseating microgranulomas' appears literally in the vignette and directly supports gastrointestinal involvement as part of the sarcoidosis diagnosis, given that non-caseating granulomas are the hallmark of sarcoidosis and were found throughout the GI tract.
